deltanet_recurrent_decode.b1h16t1d128.fp.note: warp-per-(head,v-row) register-state CUDA-graph-friendly decode recurrence (fp32); Qwen3.5 per-layer decode shape B=1,H=16,T=1,Dk=Dv=128. Standalone: ~4.7x faster eager and ~10x graphed vs deltanet_recurrent_fwd v1 (16 blocks -> 2048 warps)

causal_conv1d_silu_decode.b1w6144k4.fp16.note: fused causal depthwise conv1d(K=4)+SiLU decode token shift (vLLM causal_conv1d_update analogue); Qwen3.5 merged-qkv width Wc=6144, B=1. One launch (thread-per-channel, fp32 math / fp16 store, no smem -> CUDA-graph-capturable) replaces the eager cat/conv1d/slice/silu swarm

gated_rmsnorm_decode.b1nv16vd128.fp32.note: fused gated output RMSNorm decode (HF Qwen3_5RMSNormGated, norm-before-gate): per-head RMS over vd + gain + silu(z) in one warp-per-(head)-row register-state launch (no smem -> CUDA-graph-capturable, fp32 load-bearing). Qwen3.5 decode shape B=1,nv=16,vd=128. Replaces ~6 eager fp32 reduce/rsqrt/mul/silu ops
